metadata.source: Web search + CellMarker database + Published literature

CD8+ Cytotoxic T.evidence: CD3 complex for T lineage; CD8A/CD8B for cytotoxic subset; GZMA/GZMB/PRF1 for effector function

CD8+/CD45RA+ Naive Cytotoxic.evidence: Naive T cells express CCR7, SELL for lymphoid homing; TCF7/LEF1 maintain naive state

CD4+/CD45RO+ Memory.evidence: Memory T cells express CD45RO; CCR7 distinguishes central vs effector memory

CD19+ B.evidence: CD19 and MS4A1 are canonical B cell markers; CD79A/B for BCR signaling; PAX5 is master TF

CD4+/CD25 T Reg.evidence: Tregs: CD25 (IL2RA), FOXP3 master TF, CTLA4 for suppressive function; low IL7R

CD56+ NK.evidence: NCAM1 (CD56) is canonical NK marker; NKG7/GNLY are granule proteins; KLRD1 (CD94)

CD4+ T Helper2.evidence: Th2: GATA3 master TF; CCR4 chemokine receptor; PTGDR2 (CRTH2) is specific marker

CD4+/CD45RA+/CD25- Naive T.evidence: Naive CD4+ T: CD45RA+, CCR7+, SELL+, IL7R+, TCF7+; CD25- distinguishes from Tregs

CD34+.evidence: HSPCs: CD34 canonical marker; CD90 (Thy-1) for long-term HSCs; KIT (CD117); PROM1 (CD133)

Dendritic.evidence: cDC1: CLEC9A, XCR1; cDC2: CD1C, FCER1A; HLA-DR and CST3 are general DC markers

CD14+ Monocyte.evidence: Classical monocytes: high CD14, LYZ; S100A8/A9 calprotectin; FCN1 is classical-specific

Malignant.evidence: Proliferation markers: MKI67, PCNA, TOP2A; BIRC5 (survivin); AURKB for mitosis

Non-malignant.evidence: Normal cells retain tissue identity; reference to cell_type_annotation markers

Epithelial-like malignant.evidence: Epithelial markers: EPCAM, CDH1 (E-cadherin), keratins KRT8/KRT18

Mesenchymal-like malignant.evidence: EMT markers: VIM (vimentin), CDH2 (N-cadherin), ZEB1/ZEB2/SNAI1 TFs

Neuroendocrine-like malignant.evidence: Neuroendocrine markers: CHGA, CHGB, SYP (synaptophysin), NCAM1, INSM1

Immune/Blood-derived.evidence: Hematopoietic lineage: PTPRC (CD45) pan-leukocyte; CD3E, CD19, CD14 for subtypes

Epithelial tissue.evidence: Epithelial lineage: EPCAM, CDH1 (E-cadherin), keratins KRT8/KRT18

Stromal/Connective.evidence: Stromal markers: collagens COL1A1/COL3A1, vimentin, decorin (DCN), lumican (LUM)

Cisplatin.evidence: NER pathway: ERCC1-high=resistance; BRCA-loss=sensitivity to platinum

Paclitaxel.evidence: Microtubule: TUBB3 overexpression reduces binding; ABCB1 efflux causes resistance

Docetaxel.evidence: Shared mechanisms with paclitaxel: ABCB1 efflux, TUBB3 alterations confer resistance

Gemcitabine.evidence: Nucleoside analog: RRM1 is target; dCK required for activation; hENT1 for uptake

Gefitinib.evidence: EGFR-TKI: T790M gatekeeper mutation causes resistance; MET amplification bypass

Erlotinib.evidence: Shared resistance with gefitinib: T790M increases ATP affinity blocking TKI

Crizotinib.evidence: Multi-target TKI: ALK/ROS1 fusions predict sensitivity; gatekeeper mutations confer resistance

Palbociclib.evidence: CDK4/6 inhibitor: requires intact RB1; RB1-loss or p16-high confer resistance

PLX.4720.evidence: BRAF-V600E inhibitor: RTK-bypass, NRAS-mut, or BRAF-amp confer resistance

Ibrutinib.evidence: BTK inhibitor: C481S mutation in binding site prevents covalent attachment
